blocks.text: Defence leaders from across Southeast Asia and their dialogue partners gather in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, on October 28 and 29 for the 20th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus). The high-level meetings bring regional defence officials together to discuss security cooperation, regional stability and shared challenges amid an evolving geopolitical landscape.
